Subject: Pricing follow-up & budget owner confirmation for Finex pilot

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery call so your team has everything in one place: 

1) Pilot scope: 3 production routes (in-product search re-rank, support triage, and account summary generation) targeting ~25M tokens/month initially.
2) Usage profile: bursty peaks at EOD/quarter-end; expected steady-state ~18–22M tokens/mo after month 2.
3) Quality bar: match current latency SLAs (95th pct under 500ms for interactive flows) and keep median cost below your target.

Pricing/qualification items we need to confirm:
- Economic buyer/POC for budget sign-off (who will own the finance approval?)
- Target unit economics you had indicated: $900–$1,200 per 1M tokens (is that still the right ballpark?)
- Any procurement/contract constraints (PO required, standard SOW, security addenda)

Attached is an initial estimate (Redwood_pricing_estimate_v1.pdf) that maps your ~25M token run-rate to committed and on-demand lanes, plus a simple cost-per-1M token table. Ben from pricing is cc’d to help validate unit economics.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm budget owner and finance approver (Alicia — is that you or Tom?)
- If the $/1M tokens range above is OK, we’ll produce a formal pricing LOI and a one-page mutual action plan for the pilot.
- Schedule a 30-min follow-up with finance + procurement if needed (I’m flexible next Wed/Thu).

Thanks — feel free to reply with the budget owner and any procurement notes and Ben/Logan will update the estimate.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

Hi Alicia / Marissa —

Thanks for the token profile — that helps a lot. I reviewed the numbers and sketched a couple of pricing options in the attached PDF: committed reservation vs. blended on-demand. Key points: 

- For your stated steady ~20–25M tokens/mo, committed reservations materially lower your $/1M-token (we can get to ~$850–$950 per 1M at a 12-mo commit with modest uplift).
- If you prefer flexibility, a blended on-demand price will likely land closer to $1,050–$1,200 per 1M depending on burst tolerance and caching benefits.
- Important: prefix/KV caching and batching assumptions we discussed can reduce billable tokens by ~10–18% for your flows; that improves effective $/1M tokens. We accounted for a conservative 12% savings in the committed scenario.

Action items:
1) Confirm whether Tom (cc’d) is OK to start an internal finance discussion about a 12-mo committed lane at target effective ~ $900/1M tokens.
2) If procurement requires an SOW/PO, Marissa — I can include a one-page run-rate appendix with explicit assumptions (token calc, expected caching savings, SLAs).

Tom — can you confirm budget cadence (quarterly or annual) and whether a PO is required before we can lock pricing? Happy to jump on a 20-min call.

Best,
Ben Carter
Pricing & Solutions | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: Redwood_pricing_estimate_v1.pdf
